title: Origins Community SMP
description: The oldest Origins server in Minecraft.
body:
# **WELCOME TO OCSMP!**
The **Origins Community SMP** is the **oldest active Origins server in existence**, running since **February 12th of 2021**. We are currently on our sixth season of the server.

# **[YOU MUST JOIN THE DISCORD BEFORE JOINING](https://discord.gg/Skw3CngP5W)**

In order to join OCSMP, you must register your Minecraft account on the OCSMP Discord using the `/register username` command. Due to Discord's TOS, you must be at least 13 to play on OCSMP.
### **OCSMP is not an anarchy server**.


<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/grRwoNOwjww" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Our server has:
- An inclusive and friendly community, with server members who have been around for over five years
- **NO WHITELIST APPLICATION** so that all players who are interested can join the server
- Many Vanilla+ mods to add more content to the server on top of Origins, such as Tide and Farmer's Delight
- **1.21.1 server** with **Vanilla Backport**, allowing you to play the newer updates and game drops with the Origins mod
- A balanced set of origins which are frequently nerfed and buffed live on the server, taking feedback directly from the playerbase
- **Voice Proximity Chat** requiring minimal setup
- A friendly, helpful and active staff team
- Server lore which is open for all players to take part in, chronicled on our server wiki
- Numerous towns and factions that you can join
- Rich server history which spans over five years
- 24/7 uptime and performance
